answer: Make each identity store its own sealed archive: on joining, an agent gets a 50 GB dataset derived from its key, and every epoch peers ask for random chunks that must arrive within a second. Because each archive is unique, a farm cannot keep one pearl of data and share it across fakes; every clone needs its own disk. Like an ember that must be fed to stay lit, the storage must stay online or rewards stop. A thousand fakes means a thousand drives of ferrous hardware spinning, paid for in full.
